verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents reminders for personnel to complete assigned tasks, explicitly including security awareness training completion. That implies training is assigned and tracked inside the product, but it is a single thin mention. Missing for 10: evidence of built-in training content, automatic assignment on hire, completion-tracking dashboards or records, explicit use of training completion as audit evidence, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, security awareness training is built in — assigned on hire, tracked to completion, and accepted as audit evidence

citations.quote: Set up reminders for personnel to complete assigned tasks including policy acceptance and security awareness training completion
